title: Supersession edge
description: One supersession relation and the other Knowledge Object it reaches. This is the only block of the lifecycle document that carries another object's identity.

knowledgeRelationId.description: The optimistic identity to pass as `knowledgeRelationId` when requesting a RETRACT_SUPERSESSION correction.

knowledgeObjectId.description: The object at the other end of the edge, never the one being read.

relationVersion.description: The count of recorded state events. Zero is legitimate and means the edge has never been retracted or reinstated.

relationState.description: Two values, not three. REINSTATED is a stored event but not a projected state: the projection maps it, and the absence of any event, to ACTIVE, exactly as PENDING is projected for review.
